stage1.impression: A dark oak-slatted room with two glowing red acrylic speakers on speckled plinths and a multicoloured neon-ringed globe between them. It reads as a CG showroom or gallery installation, not a photograph of a listening bar: the red acrylic glows like lit signage, the terrazzo pattern is uniform and high-contrast like a tiled texture, the floor is an empty brown plane, and there is no sign of life (no glass, no record, the chairs barely show). A design magazine would see a product display in a generic dark box, not a specific, well-made place.

blocking_9: The Tropos pair must read as cast acrylic with structure, not flat glowing red: speaker regions lum_median >= 45 with clip_pct < 0.5 and visible edge glow and reflections
The room must read as a lived-in listening room: lounge chairs, rug and at least one sign of life (glass, record out of its sleeve) legible in frame
Terrazzo plinths must read as honed terrazzo at real scale (finer, lower-contrast chips, a soft sheen), not a tiled speckle texture
The end-grain oak floor must show its block pattern and grain under the light, not an empty smooth brown plane
Mother EARF's floor pool must stop being the brightest surface in the room; the speakers should be the hero at a glance
Pools of warm light and dark between them: the back wall and lid should carry at least one graze or pool so the room has depth, not a uniform 15-28 lum wash

defects.what: Left Tropos cabinet: red reads as flat emissive plastic/signage; lum_median 18.2, clip 2.5%, red channel saturated (r 66, g 3); internal structure muddy
Right Tropos cabinet: same flat glowing red, clip 3.7%; front frame looks like thin sheet
Left waveguide horn crushed to near black inside (crush 20%, lum_median 10), shape lost
Terrazzo plinth: uniform high-contrast speckle, looks like a repeated texture, no honed sheen, chips too large for the plinth's scale
Right plinth: same tiled speckle; plinth reads as a granite block
Mother EARF's floor pool is the brightest broad surface (lum_median 59), pulling the eye below the products
Floor is a smooth brown plane with no end-grain block pattern or grain; rug barely legible; reads as CG
Lid/upper wall a uniform dark wash (lum range 25); slats read as a repeated stripe texture
Foreground chair back is a blurred brown bar cutting the frame bottom; does not read as a lounge chair
Cut-off table/stool edge at frame right, unresolved object
Black boxes on a ledge behind Mother read as placeholder geometry
No props or sign of life anywhere: no glass, record, coat

changes.problem: The speakers glow as flat saturated red with clipped red channel while their luminance stays low, so they read as signage rather than cast acrylic.

evidence.measured: lum_median 18.2, clip_pct 2.52, r/g/b median 66/3/1; right speaker [850,340,1000,555] lum_median 30.6, clip 3.74

change.setting: inside the lantern: the pair spot
change.to: 2 x spot 35 W, 36 deg, 3000 K, aimed from above-front so light falls across the front faces and edges rather than only through the body; add a low-power frontal fill so the cabinets' faces and polished edges show reflections

changes.expected: Red no longer clips; cabinet faces show gradient, polished-edge glow and reflections; luminance up because less light is lost into saturated red only.

changes.problem: Mother EARF's floor pool outshines the speakers and is the brightest broad surface.

evidence.measured: lum_median 59.3, p95 126; profile down the pool peaks at 92 vs speakers' median 18-31

change.setting: inside the lantern: Mother EARF spot

changes.expected: Coloured shadow still reads on the floor but sits below the speakers in brightness; the eye goes to the Tropos pair first.

changes.problem: The terrazzo plinths read as a tiled, coarse granite speckle rather than honed terrazzo.

evidence.measured: lum_range 48.9 on a uniform speckle; crop at 2x shows identical chip density everywhere and no sheen

change.setting: terrazzo chip size and ground tone
change.from: large, high-contrast light chips on a dark ground
change.to: chips about half the current size with varied sizes, a warm mid-grey ground closer to the chip tone (lower contrast), roughness ~0.3 for a honed sheen that catches the speaker spill

changes.expected: Plinths read as honed stone at furniture scale, with a soft red-warm reflection near the top edge.

changes.problem: There is no sign of life and the lounge chairs and rug do not read, so the room looks like a showroom.

evidence.measured: foreground chair back is a blurred brown bar; rug barely visible in floor region (floor lum_median 18.7)

change.to: a lowball glass with a finger of whisky and a record out of its sleeve on a low side table or the rug in the foreground right third, a sleeve leaning against a plinth

changes.expected: A reader sees someone has just been listening here; foreground gets small highlights.

changes.problem: The camera sits behind a chair back that blurs across the bottom and crops a stray table at right, while the top fifth is an empty dark lid.

evidence.measured: top band lum_median 14.5, range 25 (featureless); bottom band [180,740,600,800] is an out-of-focus chair edge

change.to: seated eye height ~1.15 m, lens 40 mm, moved so a lounge chair's arm and the rug are deliberately in the lower-left foreground and the stray table at right is out of frame; keep verticals true

changes.expected: Tighter, closer, cozier frame; less empty lid; foreground reads as chair and rug, not blur.

changes.problem: The walls and lid are a uniform dark wash with no pools, so the room has no depth and the slats read as a stripe texture.

evidence.measured: lum_median 28.2, range 33.8, crush 0.09: flat, no fall-off

change.setting: inside the lantern: the trap / fill
change.to: trap 0.35 W/m2 aimed as a graze down one side wall so the slats show relief and fall off, fill 0.015 W/m2 so the rest goes darker

changes.expected: One wall carries a grazing pool that reveals slat depth and falls to dark; contrast between pool and shadow.

changes.problem: The end-grain oak floor reads as a smooth brown plane.

evidence.measured: lum_median 18.7, crop shows no block joints or grain

change.to: visible end-grain block pattern (about 80-100 mm blocks) with growth-ring texture and tone variation between blocks, oiled roughness ~0.45

changes.expected: Floor reads as end-grain oak at real scale where light falls on it.

changes.problem: The left waveguide's interior is crushed, so its shape is lost.

change.setting: inside the lantern: the pair spot aim
change.to: raise the aim point by ~0.3 m so the top of the spot's cone catches the waveguide's rim and throat

changes.expected: The horn's curvature reads against the wall.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce Mother EARF's multicoloured rims so the speaker is the only saturated colour in the frame
out_of_scope.why: Mother EARF's tinted discs are an EARF product as placed and fixed by the card; only her spot level may change.

out_of_scope.request: Show one speaker rather than two identical copies
out_of_scope.why: The Tropos pair is fixed as placed.

out_of_scope.request: Make the speaker acrylic read thicker at its frame edges
out_of_scope.why: The speaker's parts and shape may not be changed.

out_of_scope.request: Replace or detail the black boxes on the ledge behind Mother
out_of_scope.why: Likely part of the back bar or fixed architecture; if they are equipment props, dress them as real gear (a turntable, an amplifier).
